references.text: Gamaliel, son of Pedahzur, is first mentioned here as the leader of the tribe of Manasseh at the census.
Gamaliel, son of Pedahzur, brought his offering as the leader of the tribe of Manasseh at the dedication of the tabernacle.
Gamaliel led the army of Manasseh when the Israelites broke camp from Sinai.
Manasseh was Joseph's firstborn son, and the tribe is named after him.
Jacob adopted Ephraim and Manasseh as his own sons, giving them status as separate tribes in Israel.
